purpose: Defines mandatory bidirectional integrity between questions and rules.

checks.description: Every question ID referenced by a rule must exist in data/questions.
Every active question used by a rule should list that rule in used_by_rules.
Every evidence_claim_id referenced by an active rule must exist in the supplement record.
A/B outputs must not be generated when required_questions are unanswered.
Personalized dose output requires an active dose_adjustment rule plus evidence support.
Safety blocks are evaluated before positive scoring.
An active BASIC question must have a documented purpose and rule/safety linkage.
